name: [R34] Non-editor process writes an execution-capable AI/IDE configuration file
message:
A process that is not a known editor, version-control tool, or the AI assistant itself wrote an execution- or automation-capable configuration file of an AI coding assistant or IDE (Claude settings/hooks, VS Code tasks/settings/launch, Cursor MCP/rules, Codex config, project .mcp.json). GTIG's September 2026 AI Threat Tracker report describes malware (DUSTMAKER) and a DPRK-nexus cluster (MIDNIGHT NEPTUNE) doing this in real campaigns; the file list is this repository's choice of places where such configuration can run commands (exploratory heuristic, not a campaign signature). Single-stage; the two-stage agent-memory shape is R32.

Tune: allowlist scaffolding/config-management tools and, if you accept the trade-off, a node-hosted AI CLI.

queries.name: ai_ide_config_write
queries.query: source:file_event @file.path:(*\/\.claude\/settings\.json* OR *\/\.claude\/settings\.local\.json* OR *\/\.claude\/hooks\/* OR *\/\.claude\/commands\/* OR *\/\.vscode\/tasks\.json* OR *\/\.vscode\/settings\.json* OR *\/\.vscode\/launch\.json* OR *\/\.cursor\/mcp\.json* OR *\/\.cursor\/rules\/* OR *\/\.codex\/config\.toml* OR *\/\.mcp\.json OR *\/\.cursorrules) -@process.image:(*\/code OR *\/code-insiders OR *\/cursor OR *\/codium OR *\/claude OR *\/codex OR *\/git OR *\/vim OR *\/nvim OR *\/nano OR *\/emacs OR *\/subl) -@file.path:(*\/node_modules\/* OR *\/site-packages\/*)

cases.name: Non-editor process wrote an AI/IDE execution-capable configuration file
